_about: Shots for record.mjs (copy to shots.json). Each shot = one clip in out/clips/<id>.mp4, 1920x1080, 25 fps, with the app's own sound. Times in steps are seconds after the clip's first frame.

landing.note: landing page, press the sound preview

_every-step-kind.note: reference only (ids starting with _ are fine to keep; record them by name only if you mean to)

_notes: Locators: role+name (name may be a /regex/flags string), label, text, placeholder or selector; nth picks the n-th match, exact for exact text. ready = wait for this before the clip starts (the loading is cut off); setup steps run before time zero, so they are not in the clip. Per shot: localStorage {}, reducedMotion true, audioShift (overrides the global). Run  node record.mjs --sync-test  once and put its audioShift here.
